# ADR 0002: Rust core, worker-hosted Wasm, dependency-light web shell

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

*Status: accepted, with worker transaction and resource details amended by ADR 0004.*

## Status

Accepted

## Decision

Scientific algorithms live in a dependency-light Rust crate with no browser imports.
A narrow Wasm crate exposes stateful streaming and tile APIs. All expensive work runs
in dedicated workers. Vanilla TypeScript owns the interface and WebGL2 renderer.

Runtime assets have no CDN or server dependency. Large inputs are streamed and packed;
an array containing every k-mer hash is never materialized. Browser-local persistence
is optional and is managed outside Wasm.

The numeric tile contract is independent of rendering so future data export can reuse
the exact displayed values without changing the computational core.
